facts.text: The hotel is in the Deep Ellum neighborhood of Dallas, near breweries, galleries, eateries and music venues.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Pittman Hotel is located in vibrant Deep Ellum, near breweries, galleries, eateries and music venues, as well as landmark murals by local artists.

facts.text: The Dallas Museum of Art, the Nasher Sculpture Center and the Crow Museum of Asian Art are nearby.
facts.excerpt: The Dallas Museum of Art, the Nasher Sculpture Center and Crow Museum of Asian Art are also nearby.

facts.text: The hotel pairs a century-old Beaux Arts exterior with modern glass and steel interiors.
facts.excerpt: Here, our century old Beaux Arts exterior blends with modern glass and steel interiors.

facts.text: Deep Ellum is where legendary 1920s blues musicians once played.
facts.excerpt: From the indie heart of Downtown Dallas Deep Ellum neighborhood, where legendary 20s blues musicians once played

facts.text: Rooms use a palette of white walls with pops of dark green, orange and gray, plus local artwork.
facts.excerpt: A modern palette of white walls, unexpected pops of dark green, orange and gray and local artwork.

facts.text: Bathrooms feature subway tile, marble and wood.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms showcase subway tile, marble and wood.

facts.text: The suites include the Historic Sydney Suite, the Historic Pythias Suite, the Epic Suite and a Presidential Suite.
facts.excerpt:
### Historic Pythias Suite

Room Size:  695 sq. ft. – 695 sq. ft.

facts.text: Elm & Good is the hotel's modern American tavern and social lounge.
facts.excerpt: Elm & Good is a modern American tavern and social lounge that celebrates the rich history and vibrant energy of this iconic neighborhood.

facts.text: The Elm & Good menu is ingredient-driven, with seasonal meat and seafood dishes and globally inspired dishes.
facts.excerpt: Our chef draws inspiration from local and global markets for an ingredient-driven menu, featuring seasonal selections of eclectic meat and seafood offerings alongside globally inspired dishes.

facts.text: Deep End is an outdoor bar by the pool deck serving cocktails, local craft beers and bites.
facts.excerpt: A laid-back outdoor gathering place, our bar known as Deep End brings together the best all-day-into-night social components: easy drinking cocktails, local craft beers, and delicious bites.

facts.text: In the evening, the pool deck has communal fires and live music.
facts.excerpt: When the sun fades, settle around the warm glow of our expansive pool deck for toasty communal fires, live music and starry urban nights.

facts.text: The hotel has a seasonally heated outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: our seasonally heated outdoor pool is the best spot to unwind in Deep Ellum all year round.

facts.text: The pool area has lounge chairs and cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Soak up the sun in a lounge chair, enjoy a bit of private relaxation in one of our cabanas, or sip a cocktail and grab a bite at Deep End, our bar right on the pool deck.

facts.text: Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to bring your pet no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

facts.text: Overnight valet parking costs $55 per night for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Overnight valet parking available to hotel guests for $55 per night.

facts.text: The hotel has no airport shuttle for Dallas Love Field or Dallas/Fort Worth International.
facts.excerpt:
**Dallas Love Field Airport (DAL)**

Shuttle not available

**Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)**

Shuttle not available

facts.text: There is no local area shuttle at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.
